title: CobbleXPlus
description: CobbleXPlus is a lightweight plugin that lets players craft special blocks (CobbleX) to win random loot.
body:
# CobbleXPlus
> Simple. Lightweight. Native.

---

**The standard for modern reward blocks.**

I built **CobbleXPlus** because most existing solutions are either overcomplicated or poorly optimized. This plugin focuses on three things: **reliability, ease of use, and server performance.**

---

### • WHAT MATTERS •

#### In-Game Workflow
Forget your FTP client. Use `/cx edit` to manage your loot tables on the fly. It's fast, intuitive, and saves you time.

#### Bulk Opening
Players hate clicking for 10 minutes. With **Shift + Right-Click**, they can open their entire stack at once with zero impact on TPS.

---

### • CORE FEATURES •

* **Loot Preview:** Transparent drop rates via `/cx drop`.
* **Modern Colors:** Native MiniMessage (RGB) support.
* **Optimized FX:** Lightweight particles and sound cues.
* **Pure API:** Built for Paper 1.18.2+.

---

### • COMMANDS •

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/cx craft` | Craft CobbleX |
| `/cx drop` | View loot table |
| `/cx edit` | Manage rewards (Admin) |
| `/cx add <chance>` | Add new reward (Admin) |
| `/cx give <player> <amount>` | Give items to player (Admin) |
| `/cx reload` | Reload configuration (Admin) |

---

### • PERMISSIONS •

* **cobblex.admin** — Access to all admin commands (add, edit, give, reload)
* **cobblex.bulkopen** — Access to bulk open feature

---
**Java 17** • **Paper 1.18.2 — 1.21.x**
